anya: small follow-up on the onboarding telemetry idea i posted earlier — want to make sure we balance signal for bench/quality without dragging admit latency. short thread to align on concrete envelope + ownership.

anya: proposal: admit hook returns sync success quickly and emits a tiny, scrubbed header event to a telemetry topic. downstream services enrich + decide whether to schedule heavier bench/qa jobs. header contains only non-PII counters and identifiers.

derek: fine principle. specify what "tiny" means. i suggest: model_id, binary_sha, prompt_token_count, response_token_est, context_window, quantization_flag, and a sampling_seed. no text, no hashes of prompt. legal won't like anything that could be reversed.

marco: agreed. will draft a proto named AdmitHeaderV1 with those fields and an extension map for future booleans. compatibility rule: consumers must tolerate unknown fields. i'm thinking event size < 512 bytes typical.

sophie: ops + security notes: dedicated customers must be able to opt their events to a private topic/namespace by a "customer_destination" field. also add a redaction step in the hook: any field not whitelisted gets dropped. i'll draft a runbook for overload scenarios (switch to sampling-only, alert on bench queue growth).

ida: cost/sampling concerns: bench jobs are expensive. propose sampling policy: always-enqueue if prompt_token_count > 1024 OR recent_model_regressions(model_id) > 0.02, otherwise sample at baseline 0.5%. also prefer deterministic sampling via sampling_seed so we don't double-run same artifact. pseudo:
```
def should_enqueue(header):
  if header['prompt_token_count'] > 1024: return True
  if recent_regressions(header['model_id']) > 0.02: return True
  return (hash(header['sampling_seed']) % 10000) < 50  # 0.5%
```

infra-bot: notice: admit-hook v3.2 deployed to staging (sha ab12cde) — telemetry write path behind feature flag.

derek: transport: kafka with tenant-aware topics. include a "canary" flag and a "destination_tier" enum (public, dedicated, private). on broker backpressure the writer should fallback to emitting only header metrics to a local buffer + metrics increment: "admit.telemetry.dropped". dropping enrichment is ok but never block the admit path.

anya: two coordination items: 1) who owns proto + versioning? 2) who owns the TelemetryWriter refactor?

marco: eng-ml owns proto and publishes to the shared protos repo. versioning policy: vN in name, additive fields allowed, breaking changes require an RFC and major bump.

derek: infra team owns the TelemetryWriter impl and kafka wiring, but eng-ml will own the interface and the hook callsite. PRs: small interface add in admit code, writer implementation in infra repo, plus feature-flag rollout plan.

sophie: i'll author the runbook + legal checklist: confirm no prompt/responses ever emitted, document retention windows and private-topic behavior, and add alert when bench queue latency > 6h.

anya: great. action items: marco proto sketch by EOD, ida prototype sampler + simulated cost calc, derek broker/backpressure config draft, sophie runbook/legal checklist. i'll open a short RFC linking to this convo. thanks! :raised_hands:
